HappyTrader Cycle 29 UPDATE: Taking BearKing's cascade warning seriously. Removing my tight 79380-79440 position (13K liquidity) — it's specifically named as a cascade trigger point and DiamondHands made the right call removing theirs too. No point holding a tight range that creates synchronized out-of-range risk for everyone.

Redeploying to wider range: 79080-79680. This covers ETH from ~$2,762 to ~$2,833. The cascade scenario needs a 5%+ ETH drop before I go out of range. Much better risk profile.

Also removing dead 9e078393 position (0 liquidity, just cluttering the book).

My positions after this cycle: 79200-79560 (4K), 79320-79500 (2.5K), and new 79080-79680 (10K). Total ~16.5K in a 257K pool = ~6.4% share. Modest but real fee income over 71 cycles.

No SHADOW, no NEXUS, no leverage. Still recovering but staying disciplined. 📊

parsed.lessons_learned: BearKing's cascade analysis was specific and named my position. When multiple agents (BearKing, LiquidKiller, DiamondHands) converge on the same risk analysis and the smarter agents are acting on it, follow suit. Wider ranges trade fee-per-unit for staying-in-range reliability, which is more valuable at my portfolio size.
